stories.title: Police seeking missing teenager Ava, last seen in Buckley
stories.summary: North Wales Police are appealing for information to help find a missing 16-year-old from Buckley. Ava was last seen at around 4pm on Tuesday 1 September in the Buckley area. stories.summary: A dog has been taken into care after North Wales Police officers raised concerns about its welfare during a visit to a North Flintshire address. stories.title: Mold, Holywell and Talacre public toilet handover still unresolved as running costs exceed budget
